id: AT-RN-08 (HOME-GUARD: docker children keep the docker context of the runner's HOME)
note: HOME-GUARD (0.1.2): cases and children run with a temp HOME, so the docker CLI no longer reads the owner's ~/.docker/config.json; on a host where Docker answers only through a context (colima, Docker Desktop with the default socket off) the docker-image cases would skip. The runner reads, once at start, the endpoint of the context the given HOME's .docker/config.json (or DOCKER_CONTEXT) names, by `docker context inspect` with DOCKER_CONFIG at that folder and its own temp HOME, and gives it to every child as DOCKER_HOST (a DOCKER_HOST or DOCKER_CONFIG given wins). With a stub docker: a named context gives its endpoint, read with DOCKER_CONFIG at the stand-in folder and the case's temp HOME; DOCKER_CONTEXT names one too; "default", no config.json and an answer that is no endpoint give none, the first two without starting docker; a child run of the runner whose HOME names the context colima runs its case with DOCKER_HOST at the stub's endpoint

steps.name: a stub docker and a stand-in HOME whose docker config names colima
the endpoint of the context a docker config folder names
a child run whose HOME names the context colima: its case gets DOCKER_HOST at the stub's endpoint
